translation.description: Prints the call, the coefficients, and the residual degrees of freedom.
translation.details: Prints the call, the coefficients, and the residual degrees of freedom.
translation.value: degrees of freedom and coefficients from print(rq(...))
translation.example:
from quantreg import rq, print_rq
fit = rq('y ~ x1 + x2', tau=0.5, data=data)
print_rq(fit)
coef = fit['coefficients']
print(np.concatenate([coef, [coef.size and (len(fit['residuals']) - coef.size)]]))
